tokens.name: illini-orange
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (palette.primary.main). Loading/measuring modal titles. Only 3.05:1 on white: use it for text 24px and up or for marks, never for body copy. The source's 23.2px modal title sits just under that line.

tokens.name: illini-orange-light
tokens.usage: palette.primary.light. Hover and tint states of orange; not for text on white.

tokens.name: altgeld-orange
tokens.usage: palette.primary.dark, the accessible orange: 4.97:1 on white. Use when orange must carry small text or a thin line.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: palette.primary.contrastText. Text on illini-orange fills (3.05:1, large text only) and on altgeld-orange (4.97:1).

tokens.name: illini-blue
tokens.usage: palette.secondary.main; also the navy of the PQN wordmark. Deep ink for headings or solid fields; white on it is 14:1.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: palette.secondary.contrastText. Text on illini-blue and industrial-blue.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: palette.error.main. The 'Still there?' timeout card border, countdown ring and seconds text (4.98:1 on white).

tokens.name: harvest
tokens.usage: palette.warning.main (Illinois 'Harvest' gold). Warnings and the timeout card's 6px focus outline. Pair with on-warning text.

tokens.name: arches
tokens.usage: palette.info.main (Illinois 'Arches'). Background of info Alerts, which the theme sets with white text — that pair is 3.04:1 and fails 4.5:1 for body text; kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: arches-dark
tokens.usage: palette.info.dark. White text on it reaches 4.6:1 if an info fill must carry small text.

tokens.name: prairie
tokens.usage: palette.success.main (Illinois 'Prairie'). Success states; white on it is 7.6:1.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: palette.grey[100]; same value as background-paper and the button hover fill.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: palette.grey[200], Illinois 'Storm Gray Light'. It is darker than grey-300; the source orders them this way.

tokens.name: grey-300
tokens.usage: palette.grey[300]. Disabled button fill and the timeout ring's empty track.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: palette.text.primary. All copy: speech bubbles, buttons, dialogs, results. On background-default, background-paper and every wash colour.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: palette.text.secondary (Storm Gray). Progress percentages and helper lines; 4.79:1 on background-default, 4.39:1 on background-paper (just under — keep it on white).

tokens.name: background-default
tokens.usage: palette.background.default. Page ground, button fill, speech bubble fill, dialogs.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The black line-art ink: button, speech-bubble and survey-frame borders, the measurement circle, angle letters. Everything drawn is outlined in this.

tokens.name: button-disabled-text
tokens.usage: MuiButton .Mui-disabled label, on button-disabled-bg (3.5:1; disabled controls are exempt).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: MuiLink colour ('royalblue' in the source), every state incl. visited. Glossary words in speech bubbles ('Entangled photons', 'polarization'); 4.85:1 on white.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Fill of the floating 'Still there?' timeout card.

tokens.name: wash-green
tokens.usage: Sampled from GUI-background.png (top-left field). Reference only — the stage uses the image itself.

tokens.name: whobit-gold
tokens.usage: Sampled from the Whobit art: the iris ring. Reference for matching new illustrations.

tokens.name: whobit-beak
tokens.usage: Sampled from the Whobit art: the beak. Reference for matching new illustrations.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Quantum Fortune question number (set bold in a <strong>).

styles.name: h4
styles.sample: All games are in maintenance mode

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Whobit's speech-bubble text and result lines — the most used text style in the app.

styles.name: body1
styles.sample: Scan the code for a full explanation.
styles.usage: Explanations inside the measuring modal; default text.

styles.name: dialog-body
styles.sample: Polarization is the direction light wiggles.
styles.usage: Glossary pop-up dialogs and the orange modal title (fontSize 1.45em).

styles.name: angle-label
styles.usage: Polarization letters around the measurement wheel (2.5em).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Header logo bottom margin; timeout card padding and gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Header top margin and side padding; page vertical margin (my: 4).

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Left padding of the action column beside Whobit.

tokens.name: bubble-width
tokens.usage: Speech bubble width; height defaults to 250px.

tokens.name: header-mark-height
tokens.usage: QR code and Block I height in the header.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Measurement wheel, results circle, countdown ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Timeout card :focus-visible outline, offset 4px. Use for any custom focusable surface.
